summary: Bucket-fill cursor droplet does not update on a theme toggle while the bucket-fill tool stays active: App.tsx componentDidUpdate (around lines 4142-4154) re-calls cursor.applyForTool() on a theme change only when activeTool is eraser; for bucketfill only when currentItemBackgroundColor changes. U05 adds theme to the cursor memo key, but nothing re-applies the cursor on a theme-only change. List as a follow-up in the PR.

summary: Test "inverts dark-mode canvas pixel when picking color in dark theme" depends on test order: editorJotaiStore is module-level, the existing first test opens the eyedropper (keyPress i) and leaves activeEyeDropperAtom set, and the ColorInput trigger toggles it off (s ? null : ...), so .excalidraw-eye-dropper-backdrop never appears (line 127). Its red check failed before the fix for this reason, not the colour bug. Fix: reset activeEyeDropperAtom before the test (e.g. beforeEach) or open the eyedropper order-independently.
